text: dsh-license-obligation-proof 是面向 DSH 的离线许可证义务证据工具，通过 DSH tools 注册检查与核验功能。它可读取已整理的发布清单，检查组件、许可证交付义务、制品哈希、回执和闭合状态，并输出摘要或内容寻址报告。适合需要复核已提供合规材料交付情况的开发者；它不扫描依赖包，也不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-license-obligation-proof is an offline DSH tool for checking supplied license-obligation evidence. It checks artifact delivery, hashes, receipts, and closure status in a release manifest, then returns a summary or writes a content-addressed report. No API key or external service is needed.
想离线核对发布清单里的许可证交付义务是否都闭合。
Check whether supplied license delivery evidence satisfies every listed obligation.
许可证义务核验：提交发布清单后，检查组件、所需义务、交付制品哈希、回执和闭合状态，并返回逐项核验结果。

dsh-license-obligation-proof README · dsh-license-obligation-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, deterministic evidence that every required compliance artifact for a **supplied** release decision was delivered: NOTICE, license text, source offer, source bundle, or modification notice. Inputs and reports contain hashes, obligation codes and bounded metadata only—never license bodies, copyright text, package source or secrets.

dsh-license-obligation-proof README · dsh-license-obligation-proof：This is deliberately not another license scanner. [`dsh-license-guard`](https://github.com/uckkk/dsh-license-guard) already scans `node_modules`, normalizes SPDX identifiers and applies allow/deny policy. This plugin starts after scanning and expert review: it verifies that the declared component set, decisions, obligations, delivered artifact digests, distinct receipts and fresh zero-unresolved closure agree. It does not scan packages, normalize SPDX, interpret a license, or provide legal advice.

dsh-license-obligation-proof README · dsh-license-obligation-proof：```sh
npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-license-obligation-proof.mjs verify examples/closed.json
```

DSH tools: `dsh_license_obligation_inspect` and `dsh_license_obligation_verify`. MCP exposes equivalent proof-only inline tools. Reports explicitly retain `provesComponentSetExhaustive: false` and `provesLegalCompliance: false`.

离线、确定性的许可证义务闭合证据层：核验 supplied 发布决策要求的 NOTICE、许可证文本、源码提供、源码包或修改说明是否逐项交付。输入和报告只保留哈希、义务代码与有界元数据，不包含许可证正文、版权文字、包源码或秘密。

它不是第二个许可证扫描器。`dsh-license-guard` 已扫描 `node_modules`、归一化 SPDX 并执行 allow/deny 门禁；本插件从扫描与专家判断之后开始，只复算组件全集、决策、义务、交付制品哈希、独立回执和新鲜零未结闭合。它不扫描、不解释许可证，也不提供法律意见。
